code_vs_request_or_spec: Order: the request wrote 'TOUCH -> CHECK -> LEVEL'; the code starts in CHECK and goes CHECK -> TOUCH -> LEVEL (the dataclass default phase TOUCH is replaced by CHECK in _new_run_state, c2.py:1431; _check_step -> TOUCH).

350 bar: not a saturation in the controller. c2.py only raises the event locked_pressure_over_limit:<leg> once per leg in READY (_report_locked_pressure). The 210 bar force saturation is on the plant / actuator side (law C).
Output: the controller outputs leg speeds only (Command.leg_speed_m_s). The position reference is the L1 engine hook integrating s_ref; there is no position command in c2.py.

Attitude filter: tilt from the accelerometer only, 2nd-order low-pass; not a complementary filter. The gyro is used only for B1' bias, the standstill gate and the rate-integrated attitude cue of the probe.
Probe attitude limit: code ProbeSettings.attitude_limit_rad = 0.08 deg (0.02 deg kept for filter lag); D4 / CLAUDE.md say +-0.1 deg.
Standstill gate RMS window: spec 38 / 42.1 GE1'-c say 0.5 s; code uses 1.0 s per spec revision 8 section 44.1 (R5-G). Code and rev 8 agree.

The re-level attitude test (> 0.07 deg) is checked in DONE, PROBE and READY (_hold_probe_or_relevel); the load test only in READY with is_lifted. REANCHOR has its own 0.07 deg abort (aborted:attitude), which also goes to LEVEL.

probe_round_count is never reset in a run: max_rounds = 3 limits re-grounding rounds per run (docstring 'per run'), so after three rounds a later re-level probe goes to READY even with a weak leg. Recorded as observed behaviour, not judged here.
Crawler settle map: identity in the operating mode (default SlopeLimitMode.OPERATING); fitted map only in the verification mode.
simplifications_in_diagram: PRESSURE contact mode (option, ContactJudge.PRESSURE) is not drawn: there REANCHOR is decided at the first DONE and DONE goes straight to READY without a probe. The diagram shows the default COMBINED + ReanchorSettings.after_probe = True (H5a).
REANCHOR sub-stages (WAIT, MOVE, HOLD, RETURN, HOLD2, ABORT_RETURN) are folded into one phase node.
Probe internals (trapezoid profile 0.56 s + 0.36 s ramps, retract-first / skip near stroke end P6, free-air window 5 s for TOUCH) are reduced to labels.
Re-grounding runs inside PROBE (state.reground) and then sets LEVEL; drawn as a single PROBE -> LEVEL edge.
Kinematic matrix A, k_nom, J and the clearance map c(s) are not expanded.
IMU error model (bias, noise, quantisation, delay; sensors/imu.py) is treated as part of the sensor blocks.
Legacy switches (with_r41_behaviour, allow_legacy_relevel_margin, RECT probe, widen_only band) are omitted.
Events (reanchor_*, shadow_*, WARN_*) are mentioned only where they mark a transition.
assumptions_marked_in_code: relevel_load_margin_N 7 kN, B1' target 4 deg/h, probe attitude_limit 0.08 deg, Q1 ratios 0.15 / 0.25, output ramp 0.1 s are ASSUMPTION values in the code.
